fields.name: map number
fields.meaning: Map/area of the saved start point. The Continue gate requires a value greater than 0x000C; values at or above 0x00FB use a distinct special-area branch. Values 0x000C and 0x000D were tested at the Continue boundary; this does not establish every larger map as valid.
fields.evidence: Continue predicate at 2000:DEE3 checks RAM 01C01 bit 1 clear, valid section A, and map > 0x000C; source load copies saved 0x7402 to RAM 01C02. Section-A signature at SRAM 0x7443 and sum16 at 0x744B cover 0x7400..0x744A (check at 2000:E0DE). Native checksum-valid 0x000C followed opening-scene route; 0x000D entered continued scene; stale-sum 0x000D control failed section validation. Dynamic consumers include 2000:24EE/2BE4 for the lower branch; source special-area check at 2000:DF93.
